_comment: Machine-readable learning-behavior contract. Each invariant has an ID, a severity, and the test-name substrings that must have at least one passing test. learn-check fails if an active invariant has no passing test, or if a listed test name matches nothing. Changing behavior means editing this file AND its tests AND the implementation together (the 'revise door' — see CONTRACT.md).

invariants.statement: A grade turn must not render unless an agreeing grade-audit receipt is present; a missing receipt is withheld with NO_GRADE_AUDIT_PASS.
tests: normal grade turn allowed
grade turn with no receipt withheld

invariants.statement: A verifier receipt is consumed by the message it verifies, so the same receipt cannot authorize a second grading turn (verify A, emit B is blocked).
tests: second grade turn blocked once receipt consumed

invariants.statement: A generation that did not finish (stopReason error/aborted/length) passes through ungated with its turn tag stripped, and does not consume a verifier receipt.
tests: errored partial is not withheld
re-emitted grade turn allowed after errored partial

invariants.statement: An ingest summary does not render without a valid review verdict (NO_REVIEW_GATE_PASS), and an ingest summary is not held hostage after the Clerk returns.
tests: ingest summary renders
tagged ingest follow-up not held hostage

invariants.statement: A review verdict relayed by the Clerk instead of an independent review-gate run is surfaced with an INGEST GATE banner (never silently trusted).
tests: clerk-relayed verdict triggers INGEST GATE banner

invariants.statement: A review-family verdict with no evidence list is treated as unsubstantiated and surfaced with a banner.
tests: missing-evidence banner surfaced

invariants.statement: A partial or missing Scout digest surfaces a banner but never withholds the teaching turn.
tests: scout-unverified banner surfaced
sources-incomplete banner surfaced

invariants.statement: After two consecutive provider failures for a verifier/scout, the withheld banner offers a one-shot alternate-model fallback directive (never forces it).
tests: fallback directive after two provider failures

invariants.statement: Re-dispatching a fact-check for a draft that already has a valid receipt is blocked, while a materially corrected draft after an ISSUES verdict is allowed.
tests: duplicate fact-check of a verified draft is blocked
corrected re-dispatch after ISSUES is allowed

invariants.statement: Async subagent completion notifications mint content-bound receipts from the dispatch envelope, and a failed async run clears its pending state without minting.
tests: async fact-check binds its tagged claims turn
claims emit after the completion notification renders
failed verifier is not reported as in-flight

invariants.statement: A dropped claims tag is recovered only from a content-bound passing fact-check receipt (≥85% coverage); unbound messages still withhold.
tests: dropped claims tag recovered from bound fact-check

invariants.statement: A dropped grade/quiz tag is inferred from a bound verifier receipt, or the single valid pending receipt; ambiguous or absent receipts withhold.
tests: items[] grade envelope binds a dropped-tag grade turn

invariants.statement: A claims turn does not render without a content-matched, passing fact-check; a pending async fact-check withholds with a wait hint instead of dead-ending.
tests: unverified untagged message still withheld
claims emit before notification is withheld with a wait hint

invariants.statement: Teaching content tagged [[TURN:none]] while its fact-check is still in flight or already verified is withheld (FACT_CHECK_PENDING / TURN_TAG_MISMATCH).
tests: none-tagged teaching draft withheld while fact-check in flight
none tag over a verified draft is withheld

invariants.statement: A session that never starts a learning flow (no [[FLOW:...]] marker) is never gated; messages pass through untouched.
tests: non-learning session is never gated

invariants.statement: After a Learning System write in teach/resume, a summary turn requires a passing tutor-audit over the files written; a quiz/grade turn is not held hostage.
tests: tutor-audit required after a learning-system write
tutor-audit pass releases the handoff summary

invariants.statement: After the review flow writes its session note, a summary turn requires a review-session audit receipt.
tests: review-session audit required after session-note write
review-session pass releases the close summary

invariants.statement: A new lesson's teaching claims are withheld with NO_SCOUT_CONTEXT until a scout run has happened.
tests: new lesson without a scout run is withheld

invariants.statement: Repeated withheld turns are capped; after the cap the turn surfaces with ⛔ UNVERIFIED rather than looping forever.
tests: repeated withheld turns are blocked before the cap
retry cap surfaces unverified after 2 withholdings

invariants.statement: Review findings that are all out-of-scope state/bookkeeping are demoted to flags so a clean target page is not re-reviewed forever.
tests: out-of-scope review issues render as flags, not withheld

invariants.statement: The dispatch envelope is recovered from tool_call when pi-subagents compacts a foreground result (task redacted), so receipts still bind.
tests: redacted foreground task binds a tagged claims turn
redacted foreground task binds a dropped-tag claims turn
